	immediate = {

	id = cosmo_affairs_events.44736
	title = cosmo_affairs_events.44736.t
	desc = cosmo_affairs_events.44736.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {		
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3_eventPicture
	}	
		picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6_eventPicture
	}	
		
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}
				FROM = {
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
					}
				}
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
			}
		
			if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1		
		}						
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.44736.a				
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6
			}
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_6
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_5
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_4
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_3
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_2
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_YAKA_THEOLOGIAN_1
		}	
		cosmo_admadvisor_fail = yes												 												

		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair				
	   
		}		
	}			
}

	id = cosmo_affairs_events.46362
	title = cosmo_affairs_events.46362.t
	desc = cosmo_affairs_events.46362.d
	picture = {
	trigger = { 
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1
			}
		}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
			}		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3
			}			
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
			}	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4_eventPicture
	}	
		picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5
			}		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_6
			}		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_6_eventPicture
	}
	
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}
				FROM = {
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
					}
				}
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
			}			
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.46362.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_a			
		 }	
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1		
       }	
		if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
						NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3
			}			
		}
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3
       }
		if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
						NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5
			}			
		}
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5
       }
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_a
		cosmo_admadvisor_fail = yes												 

			
		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair						
	   
		}		
		}		
		
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.46362.b
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_a			
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1	
						NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
       }
		if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3	
						NOT = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
       }
		if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1	
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2		
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3	
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
			has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5			
		}
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_1
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_2
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_3
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_4
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_5		
       }	   
		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MEXICAN_INQUISITOR_a
		cosmo_admadvisor_fail = yes												 

			
		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair						

			random_list = {
			8 = { #bastard girl
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_symptoms_tooltip
			}
			8 = { #bastard boy
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_symptoms_tooltip
			}
			4 = { #std
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_symptoms_tooltip
			}
			5 = { #caught
			trigger = {
				always = no
			}
			country_event = {
				id = cosmo_affairs_events.46363				
				}
			}			
			80 = { #no std
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_symptoms_tooltip 
			}			
			}	   
		}		
	}		
}

	id = cosmo_affairs_events.46822
	title = cosmo_affairs_events.46822.t
	desc = cosmo_affairs_events.46822.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {		
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3_eventPicture
	}	
		picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6_eventPicture
	}	
		
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}
				FROM = {
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
					}
				}
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
			}
		
			if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1		
		}						
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.46822.a				
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6
			}
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_6
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_5
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_4
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_3
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_2
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_AMHARA_INQUISITOR_1
		}	
		cosmo_admadvisor_fail = yes												 												

		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair				
	   
		}		
	}			
}
